'''Tommaso Boggio''' (22 December 1877 &ndash; 25 May 1963) was an Italian [[mathematician]]. Boggio worked in [[mathematical physics]], [[differential geometry]], [[mathematical analysis|analysis]], and [[financial mathematics]]. He was an invited speaker in [[International Congress of Mathematicians]] 1908 in [[Rome]].<ref>{{cite web|title=ICM Plenary and Invited Speakers since 1897|url=http://www.mathunion.org/db/ICM/Speakers/SortedByCongress.php|publisher=[[International Congress of Mathematicians]]}}</ref> He wrote, with [[Cesare Burali-Forti|Burali-Forti]], ''Meccanica Razionale'', published in 1921 by S. Lattes & Compagnia.<ref>{{cite journal|author=Field, Peter|title=Review of ''Meccanica Razionale'' by C. Burali-Forti and T. Boggio|journal=Bull. Amer. Math. Soc.|year=1922|volume=29|page=71|url=http://www.ams.org/journals/bull/1922-28-01/S0002-9904-1922-03528-8/S0002-9904-1922-03528-8.pdf|doi=10.1090/s0002-9904-1922-03528-8|doi-access=free}}</ref>
